title: Access to quaternary-carbon-containing β-alkyl amides via persulfate-promoted domino alkylation/smiles rearrangement of alkenes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16183-16186
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02454D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xiaohu Yang, Xiaoqing Wan, Wen-Chao Yang, Hegui Fang
An efficient radical alkylative annulation/arylation of N-(arylsulfonyl)acrylamide with 4-alkyl-1,4-dihydropyridines (DHP) was developed for synthesizing all-carbon quaternary-centered β-alkyl amides.
